name.en: Disability pension (Financial Assistance to Persons with Special Needs)
name.hi: दिव्यांग पेंशन (विशेष आवश्यकता वाले व्यक्तियों को वित्तीय सहायता)

department.en: Social Welfare Department, Govt of NCT of Delhi

summary.en: ₹2,500 a month for Delhi residents aged 0 to 59 with a disability of 40% or more and low family income.
summary.hi: 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले 0 से 59 वर्ष के दिल्ली निवासियों को, कम पारिवारिक आय पर, ₹2,500 प्रति माह।
summary.hn: 40% ya zyada disability wale 0 se 59 saal ke Delhi residents ko, kam family income par, ₹2,500 per month.

text.en: ₹2,500 a month, paid to your Aadhaar-linked bank account through PFMS, starting from the month after you apply.
Disability of 40% or more: blindness, low vision, locomotor disability, hearing impairment, leprosy cured, cerebral palsy, autism, mental retardation or mental illness.
At least 5 years of residence in Delhi before the date of application.

Annual family income below ₹1,00,000 from all sources. For a minor or an unmarried, unemployed disabled person, family means the parents or legal guardian. For a married person, it means the spouse and dependent children.
An Aadhaar number, and a singly-operated bank account in the National Capital Territory of Delhi linked to Aadhaar (this can be relaxed for minors).
Not already getting a pension or financial assistance from the Centre, State, local bodies or any other source for this purpose.
Age proof, for example a birth certificate, school leaving or 10th certificate, driving licence, passport, PAN, ration card, voter card or Aadhaar.
Residence proof showing at least 5 years in Delhi, for example a ration card, voter card, Aadhaar, passport, driving licence, utility bill or bank passbook.
Disability certificate issued by a government hospital as per norms.
One passport size photo, and an income self-declaration in the format on the portal.
Not stated on the official page: verify locally.
Normally within 45 days of receiving the application, unless circumstances dictate otherwise.

Apply online on the e-District portal after registering through citizen login, or at your District Social Welfare Office. Aadhaar is mandatory: the portal does not work without it. Scan and upload the documents.
The District Social Welfare Office scrutinises the application and may call you with documents for verification.
If sanctioned, payment starts from the month after your application and then arrives monthly.
